subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should existing paired operator devices receive access to the new `operator.questions` capability through a compatible upgrade path, or should question-card access intentionally require an explicit reauthorization or re-pair?
rationale: Granting a new scope automatically changes the authority of persisted device tokens, while requiring the new scope without recovery can break upgraded clients; the intended security and upgrade boundary is a maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Add an explicit upgrade path
options.body: Keep the new dedicated scope and provide a tested in-product reauthorization or re-pair recovery path for existing paired clients.

options.title: Treat re-pairing as intentional
options.body: Require a fresh pairing for question cards, but document it and make the app surface a clear recovery action when the scope is absent.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit upgrade path
recommendation.body: Keep the new dedicated scope and provide a tested in-product reauthorization or re-pair recovery path for existing paired clients.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR owns both the new scope assignment and the affected cross-platform question clients.
